summary: Official executable plugin packages that Clash may distribute for explicit installation without preloading them.
context_hints: A package being under plugins/official makes it first-party and discoverable; it does not make it bundled
Official packages in this directory must remain out of BUNDLED_PLUGINS unless preload behavior is an intentional product change
Packages use the normal clash.plugin/v1 manifest and activation lifecycle

subdirectories.storyboard: Official View-only Storyboard plugin, installed and activated explicitly.
